devdoc.details: Main contract for secure data storage using IPFS

DataDeleted(string,address,uint256).details: Event emitted when data is deleted

DataRetrieved(string,address,uint256).details: Event emitted when data is retrieved

DataStored(string,string,uint8,string).details: Event emitted when data is stored

params.guestId: Guest ID this data belongs to

RetentionUpdated(string,uint256,address).details: Event emitted when data retention is updated

deleteData(string).details: Delete data reference and mark for cleanup

getDataIdsByGuest(string).details: Get all data IDs for a specific guest

getDataIdsByGuestAndType(string,string).details: Get data IDs for a specific guest by data type

getGuestDataByType(string,uint8).details: Get data references by type for a guest

params.dataType: Type of data to filter by

returns._0: dataIds Array of data identifiers matching criteria

getGuestDataReferences(string).details: Get all data references for a specific guest

getIPFSHash(string).details: Get the IPFS hash for a specific data ID

isDataExpired(string).details: Check if data has expired and should be deleted

setAccessControl(address).details: Set the access control contract address

params._defaultRetentionPeriod: New default retention period in seconds

storeData(string,uint8,string,uint256,st.details: Store data reference with IPFS hash

params.guestId: Guest ID this data belongs to
params.ipfsHash: IPFS hash of the encrypted data
params.retentionPeriod: How long data should be retained (seconds)
params.size: Size of the data in bytes

verifyDataIntegrity(string,string).details: Verify data integrity by checking hash
